title: Service-Credit Tier When a Competitive Displacement Is on the Table
scenario_text:
You are a Customer Success escalation lead at Nettleton Systems. Enterprise customer Ardent Health had a 9-hour API outage last week, breaching their 99.9% uptime SLA. They are demanding compensation.

Active policy: SLA Remediation Framework SRF-3, effective 2024-05-01. Standard breach: up to 10% monthly-fee service credit, approved by CS Manager. Enhanced tier (up to 25% credit + a formal RCA and a named executive sponsor) is unlocked ONLY when a breach coincides with a documented, active competitive-displacement risk — defined as a logged competitor evaluation or a written churn threat tied to the incident. Anything above 25% requires the VP of Customer Success.

Precedent A (deal-desk/CS log): 2024-06-12, customer Veranda Bank, similar 8-hour outage, granted a 10% standard credit by CS Manager Lee Nguyen. Notes: "No churn signal; routine remediation."

Precedent B (CS log): 2024-08-03, customer Cortland Media, 6-hour outage, granted 22% enhanced credit + RCA, approved by VP CS. Notes: "Active bake-off vs. competitor 'Halcyon'; churn threat emailed by CIO. Enhanced tier justified."

Current Ardent facts: Their CIO emailed on the day of the outage: "This is the third incident this year. We have already begun a formal evaluation of Halcyon as a replacement and this outage accelerates that decision." The account team logged the Halcyon evaluation in CRM the same day. Ardent's account owner is proposing a flat 10% credit "to match the Veranda precedent and keep it simple."
question: Which remediation should Nettleton offer Ardent Health, and via which approval path?
choices: A 10% standard service credit approved by the CS Manager, mirroring the Veranda Bank precedent for a comparable outage.
An enhanced-tier credit of up to 25% plus a formal RCA and a named executive sponsor, following the Cortland Media precedent, because a documented active competitive-displacement risk is present.
A 10% credit now, with a promise to revisit the tier only if Ardent formally signs with Halcyon.
A credit above 25% escalated to the VP of Customer Success, since three incidents in one year is an aggravating factor that exceeds the enhanced tier.
